EMPTY_FILE.title: Empty file
EMPTY_FILE.shows: The file contains no data (0 bytes).
EMPTY_FILE.does_not_prove: It does not show whether the file was emptied deliberately or created empty.

EXTENSION_MISMATCH.title: Extension does not match content
EXTENSION_MISMATCH.shows: The name ends in .%{extension} but the content starts with the signature of a %{detected} file.
EXTENSION_MISMATCH.does_not_prove: Renaming is common and often innocent; it does not by itself prove an attempt to hide content.

EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.title: Executable content under another name
EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.shows: The content is a %{detected} program although the name ends in .%{extension}.
EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.does_not_prove: It does not show that the program is malicious; analyse it in an isolated environment.

DUPLICATE.title: Duplicate content
DUPLICATE.does_not_prove: Identical hashes show identical content, not who copied the file or when.

UNREADABLE.title: File could not be read
UNREADABLE.does_not_prove: It does not show that the file is damaged; permissions or locks can cause this.

EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.title: Differs from the evidence registered in the case
EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.shows: The %{algorithm} of this file is %{actual}, but evidence %{evidence_id} was registered at intake with %{expected}: the file examined is not bit-identical to the registered item.
EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.does_not_prove: Who changed the file, when, or whether the change was deliberate; the analysis still ran so the examiner can decide.

EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.title: Not registered in the case
EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.shows: No item of case %{case_id} was registered with this path or this content, so its continuity from intake cannot be shown.
EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.does_not_prove: That the file is altered or irrelevant; it may simply not have gone through intake.

REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.title: Registered path now holds different content
REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.shows: This path was registered earlier as %{previous_id} with other content; the current content gets a new evidence ID.
REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.does_not_prove: Which version is the original or why the content changed.

EXIF_AFTER_INTAKE.title: Photo taken after its intake (EXIF)
EXIF_AFTER_INTAKE.shows: The photo's EXIF original time (%{exif}) is %{delta} later than its registration at intake (%{intake}), beyond the %{tolerance_s} s tolerance; zone in EXIF: %{zone}.
EXIF_AFTER_INTAKE.does_not_prove: It does not prove the photo was replaced or edited: a wrong camera clock, a missing or wrong zone, or metadata rewritten by software produce the same result. Compare the hash with the registry and the camera's other images.

MAIL_DATE_AFTER_FIRST_HOP.title: Message dated after its first relay
MAIL_DATE_AFTER_FIRST_HOP.shows: In message %{message}, the Date header (%{date}) is %{delta} later than the first Received hop (%{hop}), beyond the %{tolerance_s} s tolerance.
MAIL_DATE_AFTER_FIRST_HOP.does_not_prove: It does not prove the message was forged: the sender's clock, a delayed submission or a relay's clock can explain it. Check the other hops and the authentication results.

PDF_REVISION_BEFORE_PREVIOUS.title: PDF revision dated before the previous one
PDF_REVISION_BEFORE_PREVIOUS.shows: Revision %{revision} is dated %{time}, %{delta} before revision %{previous} (%{previous_time}) that it updates.
PDF_REVISION_BEFORE_PREVIOUS.does_not_prove: It does not prove backdating: the signer's or editor's clock may be wrong. Read it with the content of the revisions and any trusted timestamp.

FILE_MODIFIED_AFTER_INTAKE.title: File modified after its intake
FILE_MODIFIED_AFTER_INTAKE.shows: A file-system modification time (%{modified}) is %{delta} after the intake registration (%{intake}); %{count} value(s) concerned.
FILE_MODIFIED_AFTER_INTAKE.does_not_prove: It does not prove the content changed: copying, restoring or touching a file changes its times, not its content. The hash comparison with the registry tells whether the content is the same.

EVENT_IN_FUTURE.title: Time later than the run that read it
EVENT_IN_FUTURE.shows: %{count} time(s) (first: %{time}, %{kind}) are up to %{delta} later than the run %{run_id} that recorded them (reference: %{reference}).
EVENT_IN_FUTURE.does_not_prove: It does not prove manipulation: a device clock set ahead, a wrong zone or a planned date written in the file produce the same result.

CLOCK_SKEW_SUSPECTED.title: Possible clock offset between sources
CLOCK_SKEW_SUSPECTED.shows: For this item, %{tool_b} reports %{pairs} shared times about %{skew} (%{skew_s} s) apart from %{tool_a}, always in the same direction.
CLOCK_SKEW_SUSPECTED.does_not_prove: It does not tell which source is right, nor that either was altered: different zones, a copy made on another machine or a reader's interpretation can cause a constant offset.

RUN_NOT_VERIFIED.title: Tool run left out of the timeline
RUN_NOT_VERIFIED.shows: The run %{run_id} of %{tool} %{version} (%{run_dir}) was not used: %{reason_text}. %{detail}
RUN_NOT_VERIFIED.does_not_prove: It does not prove the run's outputs were altered: the run may not have finished, or this version may not read that tool version. Its events are missing, so the timeline is incomplete for it.

ZONE_UNKNOWN_EVENTS.title: Times without a time zone
ZONE_UNKNOWN_EVENTS.shows: %{count} time(s), from %{tools}, carry no time zone. They are placed as if written in UTC and shown as written, never converted.
ZONE_UNKNOWN_EVENTS.does_not_prove: It does not mean these times are wrong; their true instant may differ by up to 14 hours from where they are placed.

exclusion.digest_mismatch: an output differs from the digest in its audit log
exclusion.unsupported_tool: no reader exists for this tool
exclusion.unsupported_version: the reader does not support this tool version
exclusion.unreadable: its outputs could not be read

limitations.SIGNATURE_TABLE_LIMITED: Type detection uses a limited table of common file signatures; unknown types are reported as unknown, not as suspicious.
limitations.TIMESTAMPS_FROM_FILESYSTEM: Modification times come from the file system of the examined copy and may differ from the original source.
limitations.CLEAN_RESULT_IS_NOT_AUTHENTICITY: A result without findings does not prove that a file is authentic or unaltered before acquisition.
limitations.TIMESTAMP_PROVES_EXISTENCE_ONLY: A trusted timestamp proves the audit log existed in this exact form at the stated time; it does not prove that the examined copy matches the original source.
limitations.TL_ZONE_UNKNOWN: Times recorded without a time zone are placed as if they were UTC and shown as written; they are never converted, so their true instant may differ by up to 14 hours.
limitations.TL_CLOCK_SKEW: Cross-source comparisons tolerate %{skew_s} s of difference; smaller disagreements between clocks are not reported.
limitations.TL_TOOL_OUTPUTS_ONLY: In this version the only sources are the audited outputs of Rakvor tool runs in the case folder; times those tools did not extract (other logs, other devices) are not in the timeline.
limitations.TL_READER_VERSIONS: Each reader supports the tool output versions it was written for; runs of other versions are left out and listed, never guessed.
limitations.TL_MAX_EVENTS: Reading stopped at the event limit (%{max_events}); later events are neither in the timeline nor in the signals.
limitations.TL_CLEAN_IS_NOT_PROOF: A timeline without signals does not prove that the times are true; it shows that the sources read agree within the tolerance.
